sources.title: Kent County Republican Committee representative district leadership

coverage_note: Eight representative district chair positions are listed. Election district committeeperson seats and other party offices have not been enumerated, so this is not a complete county seat count.
notes: The county party's live leadership page was checked November 27, 2026. The 11th Representative District spans Kent and New Castle counties. This file counts only the district chair positions explicitly listed, and is excluded from state seat totals.
